verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs explicitly claim UI parity. The REST API offers 'programmatic control over the entire platform' and is the foundation for the CLI and SDK, and 'anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.' A live OpenAPI spec and runtime probes of the CLI command surface and keyless REST offer search back this up. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of complete parity beyond search, create and destroy; API evidence for account signup, credit top-up and team creation, which are documented only as web-console flows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Vast.ai REST API gives you programmatic control over the entire platform. It's the foundation that the CLI and SDK are built on.
Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.
The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.
`vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
